世界时间已安装并开启。: World Time is installed and enabled.
个人数据库尚未就绪。: The personal database is not ready yet.
人物、经历与资料，妥善留存。: Keep people, experiences and resources close.
会话已过期，请刷新页面。: Your session expired. Refresh the page.
内容未通过校验，请检查后再试。: The content did not pass validation. Check it and try again.
写下想记住的人、经历或资料……: Write about people, experiences or resources you want to remember…
分类未能保存，请重试。: Could not save the category. Try again.
功能包配置无法读取，工具暂时关闭。请重新选择开关。: Could not read package settings. Tools are temporarily disabled. Select the switches again.
原始记录已保存，记忆索引尚未完成。: The record is saved. Memory indexing is still pending.
可在「管理分类」中修改分类名称和顺序。: Change category names and order in Manage categories.
开始日期晚于结束日期，请调整日期范围。: The start date is after the end date. Adjust the date range.
开始日期请填写有效的年份、年月或年月日，如 2024-02。: Enter a valid year, year-month or full start date, e.g. 2024-02.
所有分类都可以改名、调整顺序，包括默认分类。默认分类不能删除；已有记忆会保留在原: Rename or reorder any category, including defaults. Default categories cannot be deleted; existing memories stay in their current category.
按时间范围匹配，年/月记录保留原有精度。: Match by date range while preserving year/month precision.
操作未完成，请刷新状态。: The operation did not complete. Refresh the status.
无法确认最新版本，当前草稿仍保留，请稍后重试。: Could not verify the latest version. Your draft is preserved. Try again later.
无法读取最新记录，草稿仍保留。: Could not load the latest record. Your draft is preserved.
日期可选，支持 YYYY、YYYY-MM、YYYY-MM-DD。持续至今在结束日: Dates are optional. Use YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Enter ongoing as the end date for an ongoing memory.
暂时无法读取最新记录，草稿仍保留。: The latest record is temporarily unavailable. Your draft is preserved.
更换分类会保留记忆内容、附件、关联和历史。: Changing the category preserves the content, attachments, links and history.
服务返回了无法确认的结果。请保留草稿，刷新记录核对后再试。: The service returned an unverified result. Keep your draft, refresh the record and check before trying again.
未能保存，请稍后重试。: Could not save. Try again later.
此分类还有记忆，不能删除: This category contains memories and cannot be deleted
每行一个标签。已有附件、关联记录和进展清单会保留。: One tag per line. Existing attachments, related records and progress lists are preserved.
结束日期需配合开始日期填写，不能早于开始日期；持续至今可填写 ongoing。: An end date requires a start date and cannot be earlier. Enter ongoing if it is still continuing.
编辑授权已失效，请刷新后再试。: Editing authorization expired. Refresh and try again.
编辑连接不可用，请刷新后再试。: The editing connection is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
编辑连接暂不可用，草稿已保留。恢复连接后可继续保存。: The editing connection is temporarily unavailable. Your draft is preserved. Save again after reconnecting.
缺少记录版本，请关闭后刷新记录再试。: The record version is missing. Close the editor, refresh the record and try again.
网络连接中断，无法确认是否保存。请保留草稿，刷新记录核对后再试。: The connection was interrupted; saving could not be confirmed. Keep your draft, refresh the record and check before trying again.
能力可供已接入的客户端调用。: Connected clients can use these abilities.
记录已被修改或删除。草稿已保留，请重新载入最新记录后编辑。: The record was changed or deleted. Your draft is preserved. Reload the latest record before editing.
记录已读取，编辑连接暂不可用。点击刷新重试。: Records loaded, but the editing connection is unavailable. Click Refresh to try again.
记忆及其历史版本已删除；磁盘附件和此前的备份已保留。: The memory and its history were deleted. Disk attachments and earlier backups are preserved.
记忆已保存，索引仍在处理中。: Memory saved. Indexing is still in progress.
记忆服务暂时不可用，请稍后再试。: The memory service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
试试其他关键词，或清除日期筛选。: Try other keywords or clear the date filters.
请启用 JavaScript 以浏览个人记录。: Enable JavaScript to browse personal records.
还有未保存的内容。要放弃这份草稿吗？: You have unsaved changes. Discard this draft?
这条记忆及其历史版本将被删除。磁盘附件和此前的备份会保留。: This memory and its history will be deleted. Disk attachments and earlier backups will be preserved.
这条记忆已被删除，当前草稿仍保留。请复制需要的内容后关闭。: This memory was deleted. Your draft is preserved. Copy any content you need before closing.
通过聊天添加后，会显示在这里。: Memories added through chat will appear here.
重新载入会放弃当前草稿，改为最新版本。: Reloading discards the current draft and loads the latest version.
默认分类可改名，不能删除: Default categories can be renamed but not deleted
保存、检索和整理个人记忆: Save, search and organize personal memories
无需配置，使用现有个人记忆库。: No setup needed. Uses your existing personal memory library.
无需配置，沿用现有圆盘提醒连接。关闭不取消已设提醒。: No setup needed. Uses the existing device reminder connection. Disabling does not cancel existing reminders.
查询各地时间，换算不同时区: Look up local times and convert between time zones
无需账号或密钥。默认北京时间，支持 IANA 时区。: No account or key needed. Defaults to Beijing time and supports IANA time zones.
世界时间已安装，可在我的能力中开启。: World Time is installed. Enable it in My abilities.
